config.path: Path to the git executable. Empty: use `git.path` or find git automatically.
config.repositoryScanMaxDepth: How many folder levels below each workspace folder are scanned for nested repositories.
config.commit.useStagingArea: Use the Git staging area (index) instead of changelists, like *Settings › Version Control › Git › Enable staging area* in JetBrains IDEs.
config.commit.clickAction: What a click on a file in Local Changes does.
config.commit.subjectLengthLimit: Warn when the commit subject line is longer than this (0 = off).
config.commit.bodyLineLengthLimit: Warn when a commit body line is longer than this (0 = off).
config.commit.messageInspections: Show commit message inspections (subject length, blank line).
config.commit.analyzeCode: Default for "Analyze code" before commit (checks VS Code problems in the committed files).
config.commit.reformatCode: Default for "Reformat code" before commit (uses the formatter of the file's language).
config.commit.testTask: VS Code task run by the "Run tests" commit check (task label).
config.commit.warnAboutCrlf: Warn when CRLF line separators are about to be committed and core.autocrlf is not set. Default (null): on for Windows, off elsewhere.
config.commit.offerDeleteEmptyChangelist: Offer to delete a changelist that became empty after a commit.
config.changes.groupBy: Grouping of the Local Changes tree.
config.changes.groupByRepository: Group changes by repository when the workspace has several.
config.changes.showIgnored: Show ignored files in Local Changes.
config.diff.viewer.jetbrains: JetBrains style viewer with chunk rollback and partial commit
config.diff.ignoreWhitespace: Default whitespace handling of the diff viewer.
config.diff.sideBySide: Use the side-by-side viewer by default (otherwise unified).
config.diff.contextLines: Context lines kept around changes when unchanged fragments are collapsed.
config.log.pageSize: Number of commits loaded at once in the log.
config.log.dateFormat: Initial date format of the log.
config.annotate.showCommitHash: Show the commit hash in annotations.
config.annotate.nameFormat: How author names are shown in annotations (JetBrains "Names").
config.annotate.ignoreWhitespace: Ignore whitespace changes when annotating (git blame -w).
config.update.method.ask: Ask with the Update Project dialog
config.update.submodules: Update submodules (`git submodule update --init --recursive`) after "Update Project".
config.branches.syncControl: Synchronous branch control: with several repositories, branch operations from the branches popup are executed on all repositories (*Execute branch operations on all roots*).
config.push.autoUpdateOnReject: What to do when a push is rejected because the remote has new commits.
config.push.autoUpdateOnReject.merge: Merge the remote changes and push again
config.push.autoUpdateOnReject.rebase: Rebase onto the remote changes and push again
config.push.protectedBranches: Branches that cannot be force-pushed (wildcards allowed).
config.cherryPick.addSourceReference: Add "(cherry picked from commit ...)" to cherry-picked commits (-x).
config.shelf.removeAfterUnshelve: Remove successfully applied files from the shelf.
config.autoFetch.interval: Fetch all remotes every N minutes (0 = off).
config.statusBar.showBranch: Show the current branch in the status bar.
config.decorations.explorer: Color files in the Explorer by their Git status (JetBrains file status colors). Usually the built-in Git extension already does this.
config.github.enterpriseHosts: Host names of GitHub Enterprise servers (e.g. `git.example.com`) for the Pull Requests tool window.
config.gitlab.hosts: Host names of self-managed GitLab servers. Hosts containing "gitlab." are detected automatically.
config.lineStatus.enabled: Gutter markers for changed lines (with VS Code's inline diff to roll back a change). `auto` turns them on when the built-in Git support is disabled.
config.askpass.enabled: Ask for credentials and SSH passphrases in VS Code input boxes.
config.console.showOutput: Write git output of operations to the Changeline Console.
config.jetbrainsKeymap: Enable JetBrains Git shortcuts: ⌘K commit, ⇧⌘K push, ⌘T update project, ⌘D diff, ⌥⌘Z rollback, ⌘9 log, ⌘0 commit tool window (Ctrl on Windows/Linux). **Overrides VS Code shortcuts such as the ⌘K chord.**
